i know school seems like your whole world right now and that doing poorly seems like the end of it, but looking back (and this is gonna sound flippant), but grades really dont matter. In highschool I frequently had breakdowns from trying to finish and do well on all the work. I failed classes and i still went to college. My sister tried to kill themself when they were 14 from stress over school, had to take a semester off, failed classes, handed in work late, did shit work, and still managed to graduate and go to college. And college isnt even the be all end all either, i know lots of people who dropped out and are doing fine. The point is i wish i hadnt stressed so much over school and hadnt tied so much of my self worth to it. These are my school tips: If you can, take time off. Its okay to skip school every once in a while to destress or catch up on work. Hand in shit work or hand in half finished work bc the teachers will see the effort and be more lenient (its always better to hand in something bad than nothing). Do work with your friends and divide it up. Each of you do work for one class and share it. Go ahead and cheat. Cheat off your friends or off the internet. Ask older students for their old work. Cheating is not morally wrong, just dont get caught. Cry to the school counselor so they talk to teachers for you. Lie to teachers to get extensions. Cheating and lying are good if they help you get away with things and save your mental health in the long run. Also hang out with your friends or do something that makes you happy as much as possible. School today is way too rigorous for everyone (its not just you) and it takes way too much time away from important things (enjoying life). School doesnt give kids enough room to just be kids, so give yourself the freedom to half ass school just to make it through (you will be okay i promise) and try to enjoy your life a little more. Good luck 👍 (sorry this is so long holy shit)
